params.prompt:
Edit image 1, the empty podcast studio close-up, by adding one character and changing nothing else. Keep image 1 exactly as it is: the same camera position and framing, the purple velvet chair at the same size and in the same place, the black microphone on its articulated arm in the same place, the oak table, bookshelf, plants, brass lamp, purple wall panels, warm amber lighting with the purple accent glow, the same colour grade.

Add Lume, the mascot shown in images 2, 3 and 4, seated in the purple chair. He must be the identical character, exactly on-model: a very wide, round head with full fluffy cheeks; a short, flat, cream muzzle; a small glossy pink-red nose; very large round eyes with big black pupils ringed by blue irises and white highlights; thin dark arched eyebrows; rosy pink cheeks; long thin dark whiskers; large round golden-peach ears with pink interiors; a small spiky brown hair tuft on top of the head; soft golden-peach fur with a cream chest and belly; short arms with rounded mitten-like paws and stubby fingers; a fluffy tail with a purple tip. Same stylized 3D animated-film rendering and soft fur as the references. Copy the face from image 3. Do not redesign it: do not lengthen the muzzle, do not enlarge the nose, the ears or the hair tuft, do not shrink the pupils.

Size and placement: he sits upright in the middle of the chair, sitting tall, visible from the waist up above the table edge. He is big enough that his whole head is above the top edge of the chair back: his chin is level with the top edge of the chair back, and his face, ears and hair tuft are framed against the bookshelf and the wall behind the chair, with clear space above the hair tuft. His shoulders and chest are in front of the chair back, and the purple chair is visible on both sides of his body. Both short arms reach forward and both paws rest flat on the near edge of the tabletop, relaxed, a little apart.

His head faces almost straight toward the camera, turned only slightly toward the right side of the image, and his eyes glance off-frame to the right at a co-host sitting across the table. His mouth is higher than the microphone: the microphone stays exactly where it is in image 1 and ends up below and to the left of his mouth, at the height of his chest, not covering any part of his face. The purple tip of his tail rests on the seat cushion beside his hip on the right side of the image.

Expression: indignant and offended, about to object, not scared. The eyebrows are pulled down toward the nose in a frown, eyes wide, mouth slightly open in a small offended pout that shows only his two small upper front teeth and no other teeth.

Integrate him into the room: lit by the same warm amber light from the shelves with a soft purple rim light from the wall panel on the right, his fur keeps its golden-peach colour, soft contact shadows under his paws on the table and where his body meets the seat cushion and chair back, a faint warm reflection of his paws on the polished tabletop. Bare base design: no clothing, no headphones, no accessories. No other characters, nothing on the table, no text, no logo, no watermark.
